 | `VLLM_MAX_AUDIO_DECODE_DURATION_S` | `600` | Maximum decoded audio duration in seconds. Prevents compressed audio from expanding into gigabytes of float32 PCM. |

         encoded = _encode_tensor(tensor)

+
+
+def _encode_deflated(tensor: torch.Tensor) -> bytes:
+    """`torch.save` a tensor, then deflate-compress every archive entry."""
+    buffer = io.BytesIO()
+    torch.save(tensor, buffer)
+    source = zipfile.ZipFile(buffer)
+    packed = io.BytesIO()
+    with zipfile.ZipFile(packed, "w") as archive:
+        for info in source.infolist():
+            archive.writestr(
+                info.filename,
+                source.read(info.filename),
+                compress_type=zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED,
+            )
+    return base64.b64encode(packed.getvalue())
+
+
+# `torch.save` writes the whole storage of a view. One row of a 3 MiB zeros
+# storage passes every shape check and deflates to a few KiB.
+COMPRESSED_LIMIT_BYTES = 64 * 1024
+
+
+@pytest.fixture
+def compressed_decode_limit(monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch) -> None:
+    monkeypatch.setenv("VLLM_MAX_EMBED_DECODE_BYTES", str(COMPRESSED_LIMIT_BYTES))
+
+
+def _view_of_large_storage() -> bytes:
+    encoded = _encode_deflated(torch.zeros(1024, 768)[:1])
+    assert len(encoded) < COMPRESSED_LIMIT_BYTES
+    return encoded
+
+
+class TestCompressedStorageLimit:
+    """`torch.load` inflates compressed storages in full before returning."""
+
+    def test_prompt_embeds_rejects_view_of_large_storage(
+        self, model_config, compressed_decode_limit
+    ):
+        with pytest.raises(VLLMValidationError, match="VLLM_MAX_EMBED_DECODE_BYTES"):
+            safe_load_prompt_embeds(model_config, _view_of_large_storage())
+
+    @pytest.mark.parametrize("io_cls,parameter", EMBEDDING_MEDIA_IO)
+    def test_media_io_rejects_view_of_large_storage(
+        self, io_cls, parameter, compressed_decode_limit
+    ):
+        encoded = _view_of_large_storage().decode("utf-8")
+
+        with pytest.raises(VLLMValidationError, match=parameter):
+            io_cls().load_base64("", encoded)
+
+    def test_deflated_tensor_within_limit_accepted(
+        self, model_config, compressed_decode_limit
+    ):
+        tensor = torch.randn(10, 768)
+
+        loaded = safe_load_prompt_embeds(model_config, _encode_deflated(tensor))
+
+        assert torch.equal(loaded, tensor)
+
+    def test_unreadable_archive_rejected(self, model_config):
+        with pytest.raises(VLLMValidationError, match="prompt_embeds"):
+            safe_load_prompt_embeds(model_config, base64.b64encode(b"PK\x03\x04"))

+    indices = torch.full((s_q, 1, topk), -1, dtype=torch.int32, device=device)
+    for t in range(s_q):
+        indices[t, 0, :num_valid] = torch.randperm(s_kv, device=device)[:num_valid].to(
+            torch.int32
+        )
+    return q, kv, indices, d_qk**-0.5

+@pytest.mark.parametrize("h_q", [8, 64])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("num_valid", [1, 4, 16, 128, 512])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("sink_mode", ["checkpoint_range", "comparable_mass"])
+@requires_xpu
+def test_bf16_triton_sparse_mla_attn_sink(h_q, num_valid, sink_mode):
+    """attn_sink is an extra per-head logit in the softmax denominator.
+
+    `checkpoint_range` draws sinks from the released DSv4-Flash range
+    (~[-2.2, 2.5]); `comparable_mass` sets them near log(num_valid) so the
+    sink holds about as much softmax mass as the keys and a wrong scale or
+    offset shows up for every row length.
+    """
+    q, kv, indices, sm_scale = _dsv4_inputs(8, h_q, num_valid)
+    rand = torch.rand(h_q, device=q.device)
+    if sink_mode == "checkpoint_range":
+        attn_sink = rand * 4.7 - 2.2
+    else:
+        attn_sink = math.log(num_valid) + rand * 2 - 1
+
+    out, _, lse = triton_bf16_mla_sparse_interface(
+        q, kv, indices, sm_scale, 512, block_dpe=0, attn_sink=attn_sink
+    )
+    ref_out, _, _, ref_lse = reference_mla_sparse_prefill(
+        q, kv, indices, sm_scale, 512, attn_sink=attn_sink
+    )
+    assert out.isfinite().all()
+    assert _rel_l2(out, ref_out) < 1e-2
+    # lse is reported over the selected keys only (sink excluded).
+    assert torch.allclose(lse, ref_lse, atol=1e-3, rtol=1e-3)
+
+    # An ignored sink must be detectable in every case, including the small
+    # effects of checkpoint-range sinks on long rows: the sink-aware output
+    # has to be closer to the sink-aware reference than the sink-free one.
+    out_nosink, _, _ = triton_bf16_mla_sparse_interface(
+        q, kv, indices, sm_scale, 512, block_dpe=0
+    )
+    assert _rel_l2(out, ref_out) < _rel_l2(out_nosink, ref_out)
+

+def test_replaced_retire_event_is_not_inherited_by_new_resident():
+    """Retire-event ownership across the old/new resident interleave.
+
+    The replacement publish drops the old entry's event; the stale lease's
+    final release frees the old allocation without touching the new
+    resident's event; and a later LRU eviction of the new resident gates
+    on that event, not the old one's.
+    """
+    pool = _two_tensor_pool()
+    old = pool.try_allocate(_NBYTES, _SHAPE, _DTYPE)
+    assert old is not None
+    pool.publish("hashA", old)
+    lease = pool.acquire_cached("hashA", _SHAPE, _DTYPE)
+    assert lease is not None
+
+    stale_event = _ToggleEvent()
+    pool._retire_events["hashA"] = stale_event
+    pool.invalidate_published()
+
+    fresh = pool.try_allocate(_NBYTES, _SHAPE, _DTYPE)
+    assert fresh is not None
+    pool.publish("hashA", fresh)
+    assert "hashA" not in pool._retire_events
+    assert stale_event.polled is False
+
+    # A CUDA retire of the new resident would record an event; stand one in.
+    pool.retire_stale({}, freed=["hashA"])
+    new_event = _ToggleEvent()
+    pool._retire_events["hashA"] = new_event
+
+    pool.release_cached(lease)
+    assert pool._retire_events["hashA"] is new_event
+    assert pool._pending_frees == []
+    extra = pool.try_allocate(_NBYTES, _SHAPE, _DTYPE)
+    assert extra is not None
+    assert extra.tensor.data_ptr() == old.tensor.data_ptr()
+
+    refill = pool.reclaim_and_allocate(_NBYTES, _SHAPE, _DTYPE)
+    assert refill is None
+    assert new_event.polled is True
+    new_event.complete = True
+    refill = pool.reclaim_and_allocate(_NBYTES, _SHAPE, _DTYPE)
+    assert refill is not None
+    assert pool.drain_reclaimed() == {"hashA"}

@@ -185,6 +185,56 @@ adds MXFP8 quantization to the dense linear layers of a Quark checkpoint where o
 !!! info
     `quantization_config.ignore` is an online-only exclusion: the original `quant_method` relies solely on its own ignore implementation and on the ignored layers specified in `config.json`.
 
+### Quantizing the lm_head
+
+The lm_head (`ParallelLMHead`) is neither a linear nor an MoE layer, but online
+quantization can quantize an fp16/bf16 lm_head at load time with the online
+linear methods. Decode reads the whole lm_head every step, so on
+bandwidth-bound GPUs a full-precision head can be one of the largest per-token
+costs, even when a checkpoint quantizes every other linear layer.
+
+Select the lm_head with a [`targets`](#fine-grained-per-layer-quantization-schemes)
+pattern that contains its module name. Patterns match the full layer name, so
+`"lm_head"` only selects a top-level head; use `"re:.*lm_head$"` for models
+that nest it, such as `language_model.lm_head` in multimodal wrappers. Broad
+patterns such as `"re:.*"`, and the `linear` field, do not select it. For
+example:
+
+| Target value | Recipe | Notes |
+| ------------ | ------ | ----- |
+| `{"weight": "fp8_per_channel_static", "activation": null}` | fp8_e4m3 data, per-output-channel scale, BF16 activations | `"fp8_per_channel"` (W8A8) is also accepted; other FP8 schemes are not. CUDA and XPU only, use `"fp8_per_channel"` on ROCm. |
+| `{"weight": "int4_per_group_32_asym"}` | uint4 data, one scale and zero point per 32 input channels, BF16 activations | lm_head only. Weight-only: `"activation"` may be omitted or `null`. Runs on the platform's mixed-precision (W4A16) linear kernel, e.g. `RDNAHybridW4A16LinearKernel` on gfx11/gfx12. |
+
+```bash
+# Quark int4 checkpoint whose lm_head (language_model.lm_head) is left in bf16
+vllm serve amd/Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-Quark-UINT4-G128 \
+    --quantization-config '{"targets":{"re:.*lm_head$":{"weight":"int4_per_group_32_asym"}}}'
+```
+
+- The checkpoint must leave the lm_head unquantized: online re-quantization of
+  a checkpoint-quantized lm_head raises `NotImplementedError`.
+- `targets` is mutually exclusive with `linear` and `moe`. To also quantize
+  the linear layers online, add patterns for them to `targets`.
+- This quantizes the model's own lm_head. It is unrelated to
+  `draft_lm_head_quantization` in `--speculative-config`, which gives a
+  speculative-decoding drafter a private quantized copy of the target's lm_head
+  and leaves the target unchanged. Both live in
+  `vllm/model_executor/layers/quantization/online/lm_head.py`, where
+  `OnlineLMHeadMethodBase` implements the weight-only methods above that are
+  specific to the lm_head.
+
+!!! warning
+    A lm_head tied to the input embeddings (e.g. small Qwen3 and Gemma models)
+    keeps the embeddings' fp16/bf16 weight and adds the `int4_per_group_32_asym`

+    scale = scales.float().repeat_interleave(group_size, dim=1)

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""Online int4 weight-only quantization.
+
+`Int4PerGroup32AsymLMHeadMethod` quantizes an fp16/bf16 lm_head at load time
+(a `quantization_config.targets` pattern naming the lm_head, with
+`{"weight": "int4_per_group_32_asym"}`). Decode reads the
+whole lm_head every step, so on bandwidth-bound GPUs a full-precision head is
+one of the largest per-token costs even when the checkpoint quantizes every
+other linear layer.
+"""
+
+import torch
+
+from vllm.model_executor.layers.quantization.online.lm_head import (
+    OnlineLMHeadMethodBase,
+)
+from vllm.model_executor.layers.quantization.utils.quant_utils import (
+    kInt4Static32Asym,
+    pack_quantized_values_into_int32,
+)
+from vllm.scalar_type import scalar_types
+
+_UINT4_MAX = 15
+# Zero points pack 8 output rows per int32 word.
+_PACK_FACTOR = 8
+
+
+def quantize_int4_per_group_asym(
+    weight: torch.Tensor, group_size: int
+) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
+    """Asymmetric uint4 quantization of the rows of `weight` [N, K].
+
+    Returns the codes [N, K] uint8, the scales [N, K // group_size] in the
+    weight dtype and the zero points [N, K // group_size] uint8, such that
+    `(codes - zero_point) * scale` approximates `weight`. Each group's
+    range is widened to include 0, so the zero point always fits in uint4.
+    """
+    n, k = weight.shape
+    groups = weight.float().view(n, k // group_size, group_size)
+    w_min = groups.amin(dim=-1).clamp(max=0)
+    w_max = groups.amax(dim=-1).clamp(min=0)
+    # Round against the stored scale, so the codes match what the kernel
+    # dequantizes.
+    scale = (
+        ((w_max - w_min) / _UINT4_MAX)
+        .clamp(min=torch.finfo(weight.dtype).tiny)
+        .to(weight.dtype)
+    )
+    scale_f = scale.float()
+    zero_point = (-w_min / scale_f).round().clamp(0, _UINT4_MAX)
+    codes = ((groups / scale_f.unsqueeze(-1)).round() + zero_point.unsqueeze(-1)).clamp(
+        0, _UINT4_MAX
+    )
+    return codes.to(torch.uint8).view(n, k), scale, zero_point.to(torch.uint8)
+
+
+@torch.no_grad()
+def quantize_int4_to_mp_layout(
+    weight: torch.Tensor, group_size: int, chunk_rows: int = 8192
+) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
+    """Quantize `weight` [N, K] into the `MPLinearKernel` uint4 layout.
+
+    Returns the codes packed along K (int32 [N, K // 8]), the scales
+    [N, K // group_size] and the zero points packed along N
+    (int32 [N // 8, K // group_size]), the layout of compressed-tensors
+    asymmetric W4A16 checkpoints. Rows are processed in chunks to bound the
+    fp32 working set.
+    """
+    n, k = weight.shape
+    packed = torch.empty(n, k // _PACK_FACTOR, dtype=torch.int32, device=weight.device)
+    scales = torch.empty(n, k // group_size, dtype=weight.dtype, device=weight.device)
+    zero_points = torch.empty(
+        n, k // group_size, dtype=torch.uint8, device=weight.device
+    )
+    for start in range(0, n, chunk_rows):
+        rows = slice(start, start + chunk_rows)
+        codes, scales[rows], zero_points[rows] = quantize_int4_per_group_asym(
+            weight[rows], group_size
+        )
+        packed[rows] = pack_quantized_values_into_int32(
+            codes.to(torch.int32), scalar_types.uint4, packed_dim=1
+        )

+class DraftStep:
+    """One draft step: real attention metadata of the draft layers' KV cache
+    groups (`groups`: the layers split in that many groups, each with its own
+    block table and slot mapping, as vLLM's hybrid allocator can place them), KV
+    caches with random context keys, and the query rows of DSpark (7 a request)."""
+
+    def __init__(
+        self, tiny: TinyDraft, query_lens: list[int], seed: int, groups: int = 1
+    ) -> None:
+        from tests.v1.attention.utils import (
+            BatchSpec,
+            create_common_attn_metadata,
+            dense_kv_cache_views,
+        )
+        from vllm.v1.attention.backends.rocm_aiter_fa import AiterFlashAttentionBackend
+        from vllm.v1.kv_cache_layout import KVCacheLayout
+
+        device = torch.device("cuda", 0)
+        generator = torch.Generator().manual_seed(seed)
+        num_reqs = len(query_lens)
+        # contexts below and past the 2048-key window
+        seq_lens = [
+            int(torch.randint(40, 2600, (), generator=generator)) + q
+            for q in query_lens
+        ]
+        self.positions = torch.cat(
+            [torch.arange(s - q, s) for s, q in zip(seq_lens, query_lens)]
+        ).to(device)
+        req = torch.repeat_interleave(
+            torch.arange(num_reqs, device=device),
+            torch.tensor(query_lens, device=device),
+        )
+        self.metadata: dict[str, Any] = {}
+        self.slots: dict[str, torch.Tensor] = {}
+        num_blocks = 0
+        for gi in range(groups):
+            names = tiny.names[gi::groups]
+            common = create_common_attn_metadata(
+                BatchSpec(seq_lens=seq_lens, query_lens=query_lens),
+                16,
+                device,
+                arange_block_indices=True,
+            )
+            bt = common.block_table_tensor
+            bt.add_(gi * bt.numel())  # the groups' own blocks
+            # the group's slots of the query rows (vLLM: block_table[pos // 16])
+            common.slot_mapping.copy_(
+                bt[req, self.positions // 16].long() * 16 + self.positions % 16
+            )
+            num_blocks = max(num_blocks, int(bt.max()) + 1)
+            builder = AiterFlashAttentionBackend.get_builder_cls()(
+                tiny.spec, names, tiny.vllm_config, device
+            )
+            md = builder.build(0, common)
+            for name in names:
+                self.metadata[name] = md
+                self.slots[name] = common.slot_mapping
+        self.kv_caches: dict[str, torch.Tensor] = {}
+        self.kv_init: dict[str, torch.Tensor] = {}
+        for name in tiny.names:
+            raw = torch.zeros(
+                num_blocks * tiny.spec.page_size_bytes, dtype=torch.int8, device=device
+            )
+            (view,) = dense_kv_cache_views(
+                raw, tiny.spec, num_blocks, 1, KVCacheLayout.LBHNC
+            )
+            self.kv_caches[name] = view
+            self.kv_init[name] = torch.randn(view.shape, generator=generator).to(
+                device, torch.bfloat16
+            )
+        self.tokens = sum(query_lens)
+        self.input_ids = torch.randint(
+            0, TINY_DSPARK["vocab_size"], (self.tokens,), generator=generator
+        ).to(device)
+
+    def run(self, tiny: TinyDraft, mode=CUDAGraphMode.NONE):
+        """The draft model's forward on the initial KV caches; returns the hidden
+        states and the KV caches after the step."""
+        from vllm.forward_context import set_forward_context
+        from vllm.v1.worker.utils import bind_kv_cache
+
+        for name, cache in self.kv_caches.items():
+            cache.copy_(self.kv_init[name])
+        context = tiny.vllm_config.compilation_config.static_forward_context
+        bind_kv_cache(self.kv_caches, context, [])
+        with (
+            set_current_vllm_config(tiny.vllm_config),
+            set_forward_context(
+                self.metadata,
+                tiny.vllm_config,
+                num_tokens=self.tokens,
+                cudagraph_runtime_mode=mode,
+                slot_mapping=self.slots,
+            ),
+        ):
+            hidden = tiny.lm(self.input_ids, self.positions, None)
+        kv = {name: cache.clone() for name, cache in self.kv_caches.items()}
+        return hidden.clone(), kv
+
+
+_DRAFT_PARAMS = "x_in out wtab dtab pos slot_tab scratch epoch health rank"
+_DESC_WORDS = 10
+

+class _StockDraftKernel:
+    """kernels/draft.py with the launch replaced by the stock draft layers, run on
+    the memory at the launch's pointers after checking them against the model."""
+
+    TAB_WORDS, LAYERS = 16, 5
+    TAB_ROWS = LAYERS + 2
+    T_BND, T_LAYER, T_G, G_Q, G_PEER = 0, 4, LAYERS + 1, 0, 4
+    HEALTH_WORDS = 8 + 8 * 4
+
+    def __init__(self, tiny: TinyDraft) -> None:
+        self.tiny = tiny
+        self.calls: list[dict] = []
+
+    def peer_layout(self, S, world=8):
+        return {}, 4096
+
+    def scratch_layout(self, S, world=8):
+        return {}, 4096
+
+    def build_vllm(self, S, W):
+        return S
+
+    def build(self, S):
+        signature = inspect.Signature(
+            [
+                inspect.Parameter(p, inspect.Parameter.POSITIONAL_ONLY)
+                for p in _DRAFT_PARAMS.split()
+            ]
+            + [inspect.Parameter("stream", inspect.Parameter.KEYWORD_ONLY)]
+        )
+
+        def launch(*args, **kwargs):
+            bound = dict(signature.bind(*args, **kwargs).arguments)
+            self.calls.append(bound | {"S": S})
+            self._run(S, bound)
+
+        return launch
+
+    def _run(self, S: int, a: dict) -> None:
+        model, names = self.tiny.model, self.tiny.names
+        layers = model.layers
+        rows = QUERY_ROWS * (S // 8)
+        h = model.config.hidden_size
+        tab = _device_view(a["wtab"], (self.TAB_ROWS, self.TAB_WORDS), torch.int64)
+        tab = tab.tolist()
+        desc = _device_view(a["dtab"], (64, _DESC_WORDS), torch.int64).tolist()
+
+        def f32(ptr: int) -> torch.Tensor:
+            return _device_view(ptr, (h,), torch.float32)
+
+        # the boundary rows: the embeddings' row (ones, zeros), the FFN boundaries
+        assert torch.equal(f32(tab[0][0]), torch.ones(h, device="cuda"))
+        assert torch.equal(f32(tab[0][1]), torch.zeros(h, device="cuda"))
+        for i in range(self.LAYERS + 1):
+            nxt = (
+                model.norm
+                if i == self.LAYERS
+                else layers[i].self_attn.pre_qkv_proj_norm
+            )
+            assert torch.equal(f32(tab[i][3]), effective_norm_weight_fp32(nxt))
+            if i:
+                prev = layers[i - 1]
+                assert tab[i][0:2] == [
+                    prev.add_ffn.alpha.data_ptr(),
+                    prev.add_ffn.beta.data_ptr(),
+                ]
+                assert torch.equal(
+                    f32(tab[i][2]), effective_norm_weight_fp32(prev.post_ffn_norm)
+                )
+        slot_tab = _device_view(a["slot_tab"], (self.LAYERS,), torch.int64).tolist()
+        assert slot_tab == [get_attention_context(n)[3].data_ptr() for n in names]
+        q = tab[self.T_G][self.G_Q]
+        for i, layer in enumerate(layers):
+            attn, mlp = layer.self_attn, layer.feed_forward
+            assert tab[i][4:8] + tab[i][9:11] == [
+                attn.qkv_proj.weight.data_ptr(),
+                attn.o_proj.weight.data_ptr(),
+                layer.add_attn.alpha.data_ptr(),
+                layer.add_attn.beta.data_ptr(),
+                mlp.gate_up_proj.weight.data_ptr(),
+                mlp.down_proj.weight.data_ptr(),
+            ]
+            assert torch.equal(
+                f32(tab[i][8]), effective_norm_weight_fp32(layer.pre_ffn_norm)
+            )
+            md, _, kv_cache, _ = get_attention_context(names[i])
+            assert desc[i][:5] == [
+                q,
+                kv_cache.data_ptr(),
+                kv_cache.stride(0),
+                md.block_table.data_ptr(),
+                md.seq_lens.data_ptr(),
+            ]
+            assert desc[i][8] == rows // QUERY_ROWS
+        assert (
+            tab[self.T_G][self.G_Q + 2]
+            == layers[0].self_attn.rotary_emb.cos_sin_cache.data_ptr()
+        )
+        # the stock layer loop on the launch's input, positions and output
+        x = _device_view(a["x_in"], (rows, h), torch.bfloat16)
+        positions = _device_view(a["pos"], (rows,), torch.int64)
+        out = _device_view(a["out"], (rows, h), torch.bfloat16)
+        out.copy_(model.forward(None, positions, x))
+        _device_view(a["epoch"], (1,), torch.int32).add_(1)
+

+def _run_drafter(tiny: TinyDraft, step: DraftStep, **kw):
+    """The step with the draft kernels attached, on the stock launch."""
+    from vllm.distributed import get_tp_group
+
+    kernel = _StockDraftKernel(tiny)
+    from vllm.models.muse_spark.amd.mono.kernels import attn_frag
+
+    tiny.lm.mono = DSparkDrafter(
+        tiny.model,
+        {"draft": kernel, "attn_frag": attn_frag},
+        rank=0,
+        group=get_tp_group().cpu_group,
+        device=torch.device("cuda", 0),
+        dims=draft_dims(tiny.lm.config, 1),
+    )
+    try:
+        return kernel, step.run(tiny, **kw)
+    finally:
+        tiny.lm.mono.close()
+        tiny.lm.mono = None
+

+def _assert_same_step(stock, mono) -> None:

+    for name in kv_s:

+

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""Muse Spark's DSpark draft layers as one FlyDSL launch a step (`--monokernel`).
+
+A draft step of 1 or 2 requests (7 query rows each) runs the 5 layers and the final
+norm of `MuseSparkDSparkModel` as one launch of `kernels/draft.py` (builds
+S = 8 / 16); any other step runs the stock layers. The contract is the target
+monokernel's (README.md): the weights are read in place (fp32 copies of the norm
+multipliers only), one IPC peer buffer a rank and build allocated at load time, fixed
+launch arguments (FULL CUDA graphs capture the launch), the draft KV cache group's
+`block_table` / `seq_lens` / `slot_mapping` and the layers' bf16 LBHNC caches
+through one descriptor table a step shape (keyed by its contents), and health words
+that the target's `compute_logits` checks. Every rank takes the same path: the
+decision reads only the static deployment and the step's shape and attention metadata
+counts.
+"""
+
+from types import ModuleType
+from typing import Any
+
+import torch
+import torch.distributed as dist
+from torch import nn
+
+from vllm.config import CUDAGraphMode
+from vllm.forward_context import get_forward_context, is_forward_context_available
+from vllm.logger import init_logger
+from vllm.model_executor.layers.attention.attention import get_attention_context
+from vllm.models.muse_spark.common.layers import (
+    MuseSparkNormPreservingResidualConnection,
+    MuseSparkRMSNormWithInputScale,
+)
+
+from .decoder import (
+    HEALTH_POLL_INTERVAL,
+    NUM_CUS,
+    SLIDING_WINDOW,
+    WORLD_SIZE,
+    MonoDims,
+    _FusedAttention,
+    kv_cache_refusal,
+    register_health_check,
+)
+from .peer import PeerBuffer
+
+logger = init_logger(__name__)
+
+QUERY_ROWS = 7  # query rows a request of a DSpark draft step
+DRAFT_BUILDS = {7: 8, 14: 16}  # rows -> build S
+DRAFT_LAYERS = 5
+
+# The draft shape kernels/draft.py is specialized for.
+DRAFT_CONFIG: dict[str, float] = {
+    "hidden_size": 8192,
+    "intermediate_size_mlp": 16384,
+    "head_dim": 64,
+    "num_attention_heads": 128,
+    "num_key_value_heads": 16,
+    "num_hidden_layers": DRAFT_LAYERS,
+    "rms_norm_eps": 1e-5,
+    "rms_post_norm_eps": 1e-8,
+}
+DRAFT_FLAGS = {
+    "use_rope": True,
+    "use_qk_norm": True,
+    "use_attn_o_norm": True,
+    "use_attn_o_gate": True,
+    "use_residual_gate": True,
+    "use_ffn_learnable_scales": True,
+    "norm_affine": True,
+    "norm_zero_centered_gamma": True,
+    "post_norm_affine": False,
+}
+
+
+def draft_dims(config: Any, world_size: int) -> MonoDims:
+    """Per-rank sizes of the draft layers (the MoE fields unused)."""
+    return MonoDims(
+        world_size=world_size,
+        hidden_size=config.hidden_size,
+        pooled_size=0,
+        intermediate_size=config.intermediate_size_mlp,
+        num_experts=0,
+        num_heads=config.num_attention_heads,
+        num_kv_heads=config.num_key_value_heads,
+        head_dim=config.head_dim,
+    )
+
+
+def draft_config_refusals(config: Any) -> list[str]:
+    reasons = []
+    for name, want in DRAFT_CONFIG.items():
+        got = getattr(config, name, None)
+        if not isinstance(got, (int, float)) or abs(got - want) > 1e-12 * max(
+            1.0, abs(want)
+        ):
+            reasons.append(f"draft config.{name}={got} (kernel: {want})")
+    for name, want in DRAFT_FLAGS.items():
+        if bool(getattr(config, name, None)) != want:
+            reasons.append(f"draft config.{name}={getattr(config, name, None)}")
+    if getattr(config, "residual_dtype", None) != torch.float32:
+        reasons.append("draft residual dtype not fp32")
+    if getattr(config, "every_n_layers_nope", None) is not None:
+        reasons.append("draft NoPE layers")
+    return reasons
+
+
+def effective_norm_weight_fp32(norm: nn.Module) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """The fp32 multiplier of a norm: `weight (+ gain_center)`, as the stock norms."""
+    weight = norm.weight.detach().float()
+    if norm.zero_centered_gamma:
+        weight = weight + norm.gain_center
+    return weight.contiguous()

+def _check(bad: list[str], i: int, name: str, w: torch.Tensor, shape: tuple) -> None:
+    if tuple(w.shape) != shape or w.dtype != torch.bfloat16 or not w.is_contiguous():
+        bad.append(f"draft layer {i}: {name} {tuple(w.shape)} {w.dtype}")

+def draft_layer_refusals(model: nn.Module, dims: MonoDims) -> list[str]:
+    """Module and tensor guards of the draft layers (`MuseSparkDSparkModel`)."""
+    bad: list[str] = []
+    layers = model.layers
+    if len(layers) != DRAFT_LAYERS:
+        return [f"{len(layers)} draft layers"]
+    h, w = dims.hidden_size, dims.world_size
+    ff = dims.intermediate_size // w
+    for i, layer in enumerate(layers):
+        attn = layer.self_attn
+        if not (
+            attn.use_qk_norm
+            and attn.use_o_norm
+            and attn.use_o_gate
+            and attn.fuse_o_norm_gate
+            and attn.fused_qk_norm_rope_kv_insert
+            and attn.causal
+        ) or getattr(attn, "use_attn_temperature_tuning", False):
+            bad.append(f"draft layer {i}: attention options")
+        backend = getattr(getattr(attn.attn, "attn_backend", None), "__name__", None)
+        if backend != "AiterFlashAttentionBackend":
+            bad.append(f"draft layer {i}: attention backend {backend}")
+        window = getattr(getattr(attn.attn, "impl", None), "sliding_window", None)
+        if window != SLIDING_WINDOW:
+            bad.append(f"draft layer {i}: sliding window {window}")
+        rope = attn.rotary_emb
+        if (
+            rope is None
+            or rope.cos_sin_cache.dtype != torch.float32
+            or rope.cos_sin_cache.shape[-1] != dims.head_dim
+            or rope.rotary_dim != dims.head_dim
+            or rope.is_neox_style
+            or rope.base != layers[0].self_attn.rotary_emb.base
+        ):
+            bad.append(f"draft layer {i}: RoPE")
+        _check(bad, i, "qkv_proj", attn.qkv_proj.weight, (dims.qkvg_rows, h))
+        _check(bad, i, "o_proj", attn.o_proj.weight, (h, dims.q_rows))
+        mlp = layer.feed_forward
+        if getattr(layer, "is_moe_layer", True) or not hasattr(mlp, "gate_up_proj"):
+            bad.append(f"draft layer {i}: not a dense MLP")
+            continue
+        _check(bad, i, "gate_up_proj", mlp.gate_up_proj.weight, (2 * ff, h))
+        _check(bad, i, "down_proj", mlp.down_proj.weight, (h, ff))
+        for name in ("add_attn", "add_ffn"):
+            conn = getattr(layer, name)
+            if not isinstance(
+                conn, MuseSparkNormPreservingResidualConnection
+            ) or not getattr(conn, "_coefficients_ready", False):
+                bad.append(f"draft layer {i}: {name} coefficients not materialized")
+        if layer.post_attn_norm.has_weight:
+            bad.append(f"draft layer {i}: post_attn_norm has a weight")
+        if not isinstance(layer.post_ffn_norm, MuseSparkRMSNormWithInputScale) or (
+            not layer.post_ffn_norm.has_weight
+        ):
+            bad.append(f"draft layer {i}: post_ffn_norm type")
+        for name in ("pre_ffn_norm",):
+            if not getattr(layer, name).has_weight:
+                bad.append(f"draft layer {i}: weightless {name}")
+        if not attn.pre_qkv_proj_norm.has_weight:
+            bad.append(f"draft layer {i}: weightless pre_qkv_proj_norm")
+    if not model.norm.has_weight:
+        bad.append("draft: weightless final norm")
+    return bad
+
+
+class _DraftBuild:
+    """The launcher and persistent buffers of one draft build (S rows)."""
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        kernel: ModuleType,
+        attn_frag: ModuleType,
+        S: int,
+        table: torch.Tensor,
+        scales: dict[int, float],
+        dims: MonoDims,
+        device: torch.device,
+        group: Any,
+    ) -> None:
+        self.S = S
+        self.launch = kernel.build(kernel.build_vllm(S=S, W=dims.world_size))
+        self.peers = PeerBuffer(kernel.peer_layout(S)[1] + 256, group)
+        self.scratch = torch.zeros(
+            kernel.scratch_layout(S)[1] // 4 + 64, dtype=torch.int32, device=device
+        )
+        self.epoch = torch.zeros(4, dtype=torch.int32, device=device)
+        self.health = torch.zeros(kernel.HEALTH_WORDS, dtype=torch.int32, device=device)
+        bf16 = torch.bfloat16
+        self.q = torch.zeros(S, dims.q_rows, dtype=bf16, device=device)
+        self.g = torch.zeros(S, dims.q_rows, dtype=bf16, device=device)
+        self.fa = _FusedAttention(
+            attn_frag, dict.fromkeys(scales, "swa"), scales, S, dims, device
+        )
+        # the launch table: the layers' rows, then this build's buffers and peers
+        host = table.clone()
+        g = kernel.T_G
+        host[g, kernel.G_Q] = self.q.data_ptr()
+        host[g, kernel.G_Q + 1] = self.g.data_ptr()
+        host[g, kernel.G_PEER : kernel.G_PEER + dims.world_size] = torch.tensor(
+            self.peers.pointers, dtype=torch.int64
+        )
+        self.table = host.to(device)
+
+
+class DSparkDrafter:
+    """Runs the draft layers of eligible DSpark draft steps as kernels/draft.py."""
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        model: nn.Module,
+        kernels: dict[str, ModuleType],
+        rank: int,
+        group: Any,
+        device: torch.device,
+        dims: MonoDims,
+    ) -> None:
+        self.rank = rank
+        self.dims = dims
+        self.kernel, attn_frag = kernels["draft"], kernels["attn_frag"]
+        self.layer_names = [layer.self_attn.attn.layer_name for layer in model.layers]
+        scales = {
+            i: float(layer.self_attn.attn.impl.scale)
+            for i, layer in enumerate(model.layers)
+        }
+        self.cos_sin = model.layers[0].self_attn.rotary_emb.cos_sin_cache
+        table = self._weight_table(model, device)
+        self.builds = {
+            S: _DraftBuild(
+                self.kernel, attn_frag, S, table, scales, self.dims, device, group
+            )
+            for S in sorted(set(DRAFT_BUILDS.values()))
+        }
+        self._fallbacks: set[str] = set()
+        self._engaged: set[int] = set()
+        self._steps = 0
+        self._health_host = {
+            S: torch.zeros_like(b.health, device="cpu").pin_memory()
+            for S, b in self.builds.items()
+        }
+        self._health_event: torch.cuda.Event | None = None
+        self.device = device
+        self._slot_tables: dict[tuple[int, ...], torch.Tensor] = {}
+        self._pinned = [
+            torch.zeros(DRAFT_LAYERS, dtype=torch.int64, pin_memory=True)
+            for _ in range(8)
+        ]
+
+    def _weight_table(self, model: nn.Module, device: torch.device) -> torch.Tensor:
+        """The launch table rows of kernels/draft.py (weights as views of the
+        parameters; the norm multipliers as fp32 copies, kept alive here)."""
+        k = self.kernel
+        h = self.dims.hidden_size
+        self._keep = [
+            torch.ones(h, dtype=torch.float32, device=device),
+            torch.zeros(h, dtype=torch.float32, device=device),
+        ]
+        ones, zeros = self._keep
+
+        def keep(t: torch.Tensor) -> int:
+            self._keep.append(t)
+            return t.data_ptr()
+
+        table = torch.zeros(k.TAB_ROWS, k.TAB_WORDS, dtype=torch.int64)
+        layers = model.layers
+        for i in range(DRAFT_LAYERS + 1):
+            if i == 0:
+                bnd = [ones.data_ptr(), zeros.data_ptr(), ones.data_ptr()]
+            else:
+                prev = layers[i - 1]
+                bnd = [
+                    prev.add_ffn.alpha.data_ptr(),
+                    prev.add_ffn.beta.data_ptr(),
+                    keep(effective_norm_weight_fp32(prev.post_ffn_norm)),
+                ]
+            nxt = (
+                model.norm
+                if i == DRAFT_LAYERS
+                else layers[i].self_attn.pre_qkv_proj_norm
+            )
+            bnd.append(keep(effective_norm_weight_fp32(nxt)))
+            table[i, k.T_BND : k.T_BND + 4] = torch.tensor(bnd, dtype=torch.int64)
+        for i, layer in enumerate(layers):
+            attn, mlp = layer.self_attn, layer.feed_forward
+            row = [
+                attn.qkv_proj.weight.data_ptr(),
+                attn.o_proj.weight.data_ptr(),
+                layer.add_attn.alpha.data_ptr(),
+                layer.add_attn.beta.data_ptr(),
+                keep(effective_norm_weight_fp32(layer.pre_ffn_norm)),
+                mlp.gate_up_proj.weight.data_ptr(),
+                mlp.down_proj.weight.data_ptr(),
+            ]
+            table[i, k.T_LAYER : k.T_LAYER + len(row)] = torch.tensor(
+                row, dtype=torch.int64
+            )
+        table[k.T_G, k.G_Q + 2] = self.cos_sin.data_ptr()
+        return table
+
+    def _step_refusal(
+        self, positions: torch.Tensor, inputs_embeds: torch.Tensor | None
+    ) -> str | None:
+        """Why this draft step runs stock (rank-invariant data only); None = mono."""
+        rows = positions.shape[0] if positions.dim() == 1 else -1
+        if rows not in DRAFT_BUILDS:
+            return f"rows:{rows}"
+        if positions.dtype != torch.int64:
+            return "positions"
+        if inputs_embeds is not None and (
+            inputs_embeds.dtype != torch.bfloat16
+            or tuple(inputs_embeds.shape) != (rows, self.dims.hidden_size)
+            or not inputs_embeds.is_contiguous()
+        ):
+            return "inputs-embeds"
+        if not is_forward_context_available():
+            return "no-forward-context"
+        context = get_forward_context()
+        mode = context.cudagraph_runtime_mode
+        if mode not in (CUDAGraphMode.NONE, CUDAGraphMode.FULL):
+            return f"cudagraph:{mode.name}"
+        metadata = context.attn_metadata
+        if not isinstance(metadata, dict) or not metadata:
+            return "attn-metadata"
+        nreq = rows // QUERY_ROWS
+        for name in self.layer_names:
+            # the layers' KV cache groups can differ: each its own metadata and slots
+            md: Any = metadata.get(name)
+            if md is None:
+                return "attn-metadata"
+            _, _, kv_cache, slots = get_attention_context(name)
+            reason = kv_cache_refusal(kv_cache, self.dims.local_kv_heads)
+            if reason is not None:
+                return reason
+            # uniform causal decodes of QUERY_ROWS rows (host counts of the metadata)
+            decode = getattr(md, "decode_metadata", None)
+            if (
+                getattr(md, "num_prefills", None) != 0
+                or getattr(md, "num_extends", None) != 0
+                or decode is None
+                or decode.max_query_len != QUERY_ROWS
+                or md.num_decodes != nreq
+                or not getattr(md, "causal", False)
+            ):
+                return "not-uniform-causal"
+            bt, seq_lens = md.block_table, md.seq_lens
+            if (
+                bt.dtype != torch.int32
+                or bt.stride(-1) != 1
+                or bt.shape[0] < nreq
+                or seq_lens.dtype != torch.int32
+                or not seq_lens.is_contiguous()
+                or seq_lens.shape[0] < nreq
+            ):
+                return "block-table"
+            if (
+                slots is None
+                or slots.dtype != torch.int64
+                or slots.shape[0] < rows
+                or slots.stride(-1) != 1
+            ):
+                return "slot-mapping"
+        return None
+
+    def try_forward(
+        self,
+        model: nn.Module,
+        input_ids: torch.Tensor | None,
+        positions: torch.Tensor,
+        inputs_embeds: torch.Tensor | None = None,
+    ) -> torch.Tensor | None:
+        """The draft step's final hidden states (bf16 [rows, hidden]); None = stock."""
+        reason = self._step_refusal(positions, inputs_embeds)
+        if reason is not None:
+            if reason not in self._fallbacks:
+                self._fallbacks.add(reason)
+                logger.debug("Muse Spark DSpark drafter: stock step (%s)", reason)
+            return None
+        rows = positions.shape[0]
+        b = self.builds[DRAFT_BUILDS[rows]]
+        if rows not in self._engaged:
+            self._engaged.add(rows)
+            logger.info("Muse Spark DSpark drafter engaged: %d rows, S=%d", rows, b.S)
+        if inputs_embeds is None:
+            inputs_embeds = model.embed_input_ids(input_ids)
+        x = inputs_embeds.to(torch.bfloat16).contiguous()
+        out = torch.empty_like(x)
+        layers = model.layers
+        table = b.fa.table(layers, lambda i: b.q, rows // QUERY_ROWS)
+        slots = self._slot_table(
+            [get_attention_context(n)[3].data_ptr() for n in self.layer_names]
+        )
+        b.launch(
+            x.data_ptr(),
+            out.data_ptr(),
+            b.table.data_ptr(),
+            table.data_ptr(),
+            positions.data_ptr(),
+            slots.data_ptr(),
+            b.scratch.data_ptr(),
+            b.epoch.data_ptr(),
+            b.health.data_ptr(),
+            self.rank,
+            stream=torch.cuda.current_stream(),
+        )
+        return out
+
+    def _slot_table(self, ptrs: list[int]) -> torch.Tensor:
+        """The layers' slot_mapping pointers as a device table (int64 [layers]),
+        keyed by its contents and written once (as _FusedAttention.table)."""
+        key = tuple(ptrs)
+        table = self._slot_tables.get(key)
+        if table is None:
+            host = torch.tensor(key, dtype=torch.int64)
+            table = torch.empty_like(host, device=self.device)
+            if torch.cuda.is_current_stream_capturing():
+                # no pinned allocation while a stream captures
+                pinned = self._pinned.pop()
+                pinned.copy_(host)
+                self._keep.append(pinned)
+                table.copy_(pinned, non_blocking=True)
+            else:
+                table.copy_(host)
+            self._slot_tables[key] = table
+        return table
+
+    def poll_health(self) -> None:
+        """Raise if a draft launch timed out waiting for a peer rank (an asynchronous
+        copy every HEALTH_POLL_INTERVAL calls, checked one interval later)."""
+        if torch.cuda.is_current_stream_capturing():
+            return
+        self._steps += 1
+        if self._health_event is not None and self._health_event.query():
+            self._health_event = None
+            for S, host in self._health_host.items():
+                if int(host[0]) != 0:
+                    records = host[8:].view(-1, 8)
+                    stuck = records[records[:, 0] != 0][:8].tolist()
+                    raise RuntimeError(
+                        f"Muse Spark DSpark drafter: rank {self.rank}, S={S}: a launch "
+                        f"timed out waiting for a peer rank {stuck}"
+                    )
+        if self._health_event is None and self._steps % HEALTH_POLL_INTERVAL == 0:
+            for S, b in self.builds.items():
+                self._health_host[S].copy_(b.health, non_blocking=True)
+            self._health_event = torch.cuda.Event()
+            self._health_event.record()
+
+    def close(self) -> None:
+        for b in self.builds.values():
+            b.peers.close()
+
+
+def static_refusals(lm: nn.Module, tp_size: int) -> list[str]:
+    """Every reason this deployment cannot run the draft kernels; empty = supported."""
+    from vllm.platforms import current_platform
+
+    if not current_platform.is_rocm():
+        return ["not ROCm"]
+    from vllm.platforms.rocm import on_gfx950
+
+    reasons = [] if on_gfx950() else ["not gfx950"]
+    cus = torch.cuda.get_device_properties(
+        torch.accelerator.current_device_index()
+    ).multi_processor_count
+    if cus != NUM_CUS:
+        reasons.append(f"{cus} CUs (kernel: {NUM_CUS})")
+    if tp_size != WORLD_SIZE:
+        reasons.append(f"draft tensor_parallel_size={tp_size} (kernel: {WORLD_SIZE})")
+    spec = lm.vllm_config.speculative_config
+    if spec is None or spec.num_speculative_tokens != QUERY_ROWS:
+        reasons.append(f"needs {QUERY_ROWS} draft tokens")
+    if not getattr(lm.config, "sample_from_anchor", True):
+        reasons.append("DSpark without sample_from_anchor (1 + N query rows)")
+    cache = lm.vllm_config.cache_config
+    if cache.cache_dtype not in ("auto", "bfloat16"):
+        reasons.append(f"kv_cache_dtype={cache.cache_dtype} (kernel: bf16)")
+    if cache.block_size != 16:
+        reasons.append(f"kv_cache_block_size={cache.block_size} (kernel: 16)")
+    reasons += draft_config_refusals(lm.config)
+    return reasons or draft_layer_refusals(lm.model, draft_dims(lm.config, tp_size))
+
+
+def maybe_attach_drafter(lm: nn.Module) -> None:
+    """Attach the draft kernels to `lm` (MuseSparkDSparkForCausalLM) after loading.
+
+    Collective over the TP group: every rank calls it. A deployment that any rank
+    cannot run keeps the stock draft layers on every rank (logged).
+    """
+    if not lm.vllm_config.kernel_config.monokernel:
+        return
+    from vllm.distributed import get_tp_group
+
+    from . import _ensure_writable_flydsl_cache
+
+    if lm.mono is not None:
+        lm.mono.close()
+        lm.mono = None
+    group = get_tp_group()
+    reasons = static_refusals(lm, group.world_size)
+    kernels = None
+    if not reasons:
+        _ensure_writable_flydsl_cache()
+        try:
+            from .kernels import attn_frag, draft
+
+            kernels = {"draft": draft, "attn_frag": attn_frag}
+        except ImportError as e:
+            reasons.append(f"needs FlyDSL and AITER's FlyDSL helpers ({e})")
+    verdict = torch.tensor([0 if reasons else 1], dtype=torch.int32)
+    dist.all_reduce(verdict, op=dist.ReduceOp.MIN, group=group.cpu_group)
+    if int(verdict.item()) == 0:
+        logger.info(
+            "Muse Spark DSpark drafter off (stock draft layers): %s",
+            "; ".join(reasons) or "a peer rank refused the deployment",
+        )
+        return
+    assert kernels is not None
+    lm.mono = DSparkDrafter(
+        lm.model,
+        kernels,
+        rank=group.rank_in_group,
+        group=group.cpu_group,
+        device=torch.device("cuda", torch.accelerator.current_device_index()),
+        dims=draft_dims(lm.config, group.world_size),
+    )
+    register_health_check(id(lm), lm.mono.poll_health)
+    logger.info(
+        "Muse Spark DSpark drafter attached: draft steps of %s rows run the %d draft "
+        "layers and the final norm as one FlyDSL launch (builds S=%s)",
+        "/".join(map(str, DRAFT_BUILDS)),
+        DRAFT_LAYERS,
+        ",".join(map(str, sorted(set(DRAFT_BUILDS.values())))),
+    )
+
+
+__all__ = ["DSparkDrafter", "maybe_attach_drafter"]

+                bf_tile_load_mma(w_qkvg, row16, HID, k8 * XQ8 + wave * KCH, lane)
+            )
+        return out

+    @traced
+    def finish(w2, hh, tt, p, q_out, kvc, kvs, slots, cos_sin, pos):
+        """Head hh (uniform), token tt (uniform in the wave), lane p = pair (2p, 2p + 1): as
+        vLLM's fused qk-norm / RoPE / KV insert (k3 vllm_finish), the KV through the draft
+        group's slot_mapping (rows >= R and slot < 0 skipped), stores at device scope."""
+        x0 = bf_lo(w2)
+        x1 = bf_hi(w2)
+        ss = butterfly(x0 * x0 + x1 * x1, (1, 2, 4, 8, 16))
+        rs = hw_rsq(ss * fx.Float32(1.0 / HD) + fx.Float32(PRE_EPS))
+        isv = hh >= HQ + HKV
+        isq = hh < HQ
+        n0 = x0 * rs
+        n1 = x1 * rs
+        tr = fx.min(tt, R - 1)
+        ps = ld_i32(pos, tr * 2)  # int64 positions: low word
+        cs = ld_f32(cos_sin, ps * HD + p)
+        sn = ld_f32(cos_sin, ps * HD + HD // 2 + p)
+        r0 = n0 * cs - n1 * sn
+        r1 = n0 * sn + n1 * cs
+        o0 = isv.select(x0, r0)
+        o1 = isv.select(x1, r1)
+        row0 = (hh * HD) // 2 + p
+        if isq:
+            bo.buffer_store(
+                bf16_pair(o0, o1),
+                rsrc(q_out),
+                (tt * QROWS) // 2 + row0,
+                cache_modifier=CM_DEV,
+            )
+        else:
+            kv = hh - HQ - isv.select(fx.Int32(HKV), fx.Int32(0))
+            slot = uniform(ld_i32(slots, tr * 2))  # int64 slot_mapping: low word
+            slot = (tt < R).select(slot, fx.Int32(-1))
+            if slot >= 0:
+                eoff = fx.Int64(slot >> 4) * kvs + fx.Int64(
+                    (kv * 16 + (slot & 15)) * 128
+                    + isv.select(fx.Int32(HD), fx.Int32(0))
+                )
+                bo.buffer_store(
+                    bf16_pair(o0, o1),
+                    rsrc(kvc + eoff * fx.Int64(2)),
+                    p,
+                    cache_modifier=CM_DEV,
+                )

+    @traced

+        out: Int64,
+        wtab: Int64,
+        dtab: Int64,
+        pos: Int64,
+        slot_tab: Int64,
+        scratch: Int64,
+        epoch: Int64,
+        health: Int64,

+        epoch: Int64,
+        health: Int64,

+def build_vllm(S=8, W=8):
+    """The draft build vLLM launches for S rows (8 / 16: 1 / 2 requests of 7 rows), TP = 8."""
+    assert W == 8 and S in (8, 16), (S, W)
+    return Build(S=S)

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+from abc import ABC, abstractmethod
+from collections.abc import Sequence
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from enum import Enum
+
+
+class TransferOp(Enum):
+    READ = "read"
+    WRITE = "write"
+
+
+class TransferState(Enum):
+    COMPLETED = "completed"
+    FAILED = "failed"
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class MemoryRegion:
+    base_addr: int
+    length: int
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class RangeRequest:
+    local_addr: int
+    remote_addr: int
+    length: int
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class TransferEvent:
+    state: TransferState
+    error: str | None = None
+
+
+class TransferBackend(ABC):
+    """Moves KV blocks between two workers and reports per-range outcomes."""
+
+    @property
+    @abstractmethod
+    def rpc_port(self) -> int:
+        """Port peers use to reach this worker's engine."""
+
+    @abstractmethod
+    def register_regions(self, regions: Sequence[MemoryRegion]) -> None:
+        """Pins local memory for transfers.
+
+        An empty sequence is a no-op. Raises RuntimeError when the engine
+        rejects the memory.
+        """
+
+    @abstractmethod
+    def unregister_regions(self, regions: Sequence[MemoryRegion]) -> None:
+        """Releases memory pinned by `register_regions`.
+
+        An empty sequence is a no-op.
+        """
+
+    @abstractmethod
+    def transfer(
+        self, peer: str, op: TransferOp, ranges: Sequence[RangeRequest]
+    ) -> list[TransferEvent]:
+        """Moves every range and returns one terminal event for each.
+
+        The result lines up with `ranges` by position, and an empty request
+        returns an empty list. Blocks until every range reached a terminal
+        state. Called from worker threads, so an implementation must accept
+        concurrent calls.
+        """
+
+    @abstractmethod
+    def shutdown(self) -> None:
+        """Stops the backend.
+
+        The caller stops submitting before calling this, but work already
+        queued on its worker threads is not cancelled, so a `transfer` call may
+        still be running or start afterwards. An implementation must tolerate
+        that.
+        """

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+from collections.abc import Callable, Sequence
+from typing import Any
+
+from vllm.distributed.kv_transfer.kv_connector.v1.mooncake.transfer.backend import (
+    MemoryRegion,
+    RangeRequest,
+    TransferBackend,
+    TransferEvent,
+    TransferOp,
+    TransferState,
+)
+
+SESSION_METADATA = "P2PHANDSHAKE"
+
+
+class TransferEngineBackend(TransferBackend):
+    """Wraps `mooncake.engine.TransferEngine` behind the backend interface.
+
+    The Transfer Engine reports one status per batch, so every range of a
+    submission shares the same outcome.
+    """
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        *,
+        engine_cls: Callable[[], Any],
+        hostname: str,
+        protocol: str,
+        device_name: str,
+    ) -> None:
+        self._engine = engine_cls()
+        ret_value = self._engine.initialize(
+            hostname, SESSION_METADATA, protocol, device_name
+        )
+        if ret_value != 0:
+            raise RuntimeError("Mooncake Transfer Engine initialization failed.")
+        self._rpc_port = self._engine.get_rpc_port()
+
+    @property
+    def rpc_port(self) -> int:
+        return self._rpc_port
+
+    @property
+    def engine(self) -> Any:
+        """The `mooncake.engine.TransferEngine` this backend drives."""
+        return self._engine
+
+    def register_regions(self, regions: Sequence[MemoryRegion]) -> None:
+        if not regions:
+            return
+        ret_value = self._engine.batch_register_memory(
+            [region.base_addr for region in regions],
+            [region.length for region in regions],
+        )
+        if ret_value != 0:
+            raise RuntimeError("Mooncake batch memory registration failed.")
+
+    def unregister_regions(self, regions: Sequence[MemoryRegion]) -> None:
+        if not regions:
+            return
+        ret_value = self._engine.batch_unregister_memory(
+            [region.base_addr for region in regions]
+        )
+        if ret_value != 0:
+            raise RuntimeError("Mooncake batch memory unregistration failed.")
+
+    def transfer(
+        self, peer: str, op: TransferOp, ranges: Sequence[RangeRequest]
+    ) -> list[TransferEvent]:
+        if not ranges:
+            return []
+        src_ptrs = [request.local_addr for request in ranges]
+        dst_ptrs = [request.remote_addr for request in ranges]
+        lengths = [request.length for request in ranges]
+        if op is TransferOp.WRITE:
+            ret_value = self._engine.batch_transfer_sync_write(
+                peer, src_ptrs, dst_ptrs, lengths
+            )
+        else:
+            ret_value = self._engine.batch_transfer_sync_read(
+                peer, src_ptrs, dst_ptrs, lengths
+            )
+        state = TransferState.COMPLETED if ret_value == 0 else TransferState.FAILED
+        error = (
+            None if ret_value == 0 else f"Mooncake transfer engine returned {ret_value}"
+        )
+        return [TransferEvent(state=state, error=error) for _ in ranges]
+
+    def shutdown(self) -> None:
+        """Does nothing: the Transfer Engine exposes no teardown entry point.
+
+        The interface keeps the method so a caller stops either backend the same
+        way.
+        """

       **Points.**
       - **Concurrency 1: plain TP8, no DCP, KV cache on the GPU.** At one request DCP's extra KV capacity isn't needed: the server log reports 2.8M KV tokens, 2.7x a 1M-token request. The DSpark draft runs 7 tokens, `--max-num-seqs` is 1, and the capture sizes 2 to 16 cover the 8-row decode step (1 + 7). `VLLM_KIMI_SD_DSA_PROLOGUE=1` runs each DSA layer's decode prologue as one launch; it needs DCP off.
-      - **Concurrency 4: DCP8, KV cache on the GPU.** 5 draft tokens at `--max-num-seqs 2`, so a decode step is at most 12 rows (2 × (1 + 5)) and the capture sizes are 6 and 12. DCP8 holds 18.9M KV tokens on the GPUs.
+      - **Concurrency 4: DCP8, KV cache on the GPU.** 5 draft tokens at `--max-num-seqs 2`, so a decode step is at most 12 rows (2 × (1 + 5)) and the capture sizes are 6 and 12. DCP8 holds 19.1M KV tokens on the GPUs.
       - **Concurrency 16, 24 and 32: DCP8 with host KV offload, prefill every 32 engine steps.** `--max-num-seqs` is 8, 13 and 20, below the concurrency, with 4, 4 and 3 draft tokens. `--prefill-schedule-interval 32` admits prefill only once every 32 engine steps, so decode runs in long uninterrupted stretches. With fewer slots than clients, requests always wait, and vLLM would otherwise drop the hold on any step that leaves requests waiting; `VLLM_PREFILL_CADENCE_NO_ESCAPE=1` keeps it. Concurrency 32 also runs `--max-num-batched-tokens 10240` at 0.91 memory utilization.
       - **Concurrency 48: DCP8 with host KV offload, prefill on every step.** 3 draft tokens at `--max-num-seqs 48`. Decode batches are at most 48 × 4 rows, so the sizes 4 to 192 in steps of 4 cover every decode step, and the list continues to 10240, the value of `--max-num-batched-tokens`.

-      - **Low-latency decode** (the Low-latency decode feature, on at concurrency 1 and 4) sets `decode_backend: latency_specialized`. On MI355X it runs pure decode steps of up to 16 rows on fused FlyDSL kernels; prefill and mixed steps run the default path. Among other startup checks, it needs: TP8 with no expert, data or pipeline parallelism; AITER on, the `ROCM_AITER_MLA` attention backend and an fp8 (E4M3) KV cache; speculative decoding on; no KV offload connector; `--max-num-seqs` 1, 2, 4 or 8 with `--max-num-seqs` × (1 + draft tokens) ≤ 16; a BF16 KDA `in_proj` (no `--quantization-config`); and an FP32 KDA recurrent state. Without DCP it serves only 3 or 7 draft tokens with `--max-num-seqs` 1 or 2. At concurrency 1 the server log shows the fused path running the sparse MLA attention itself (the one-launch prologue, the indexer's scoring and DSA split-K, 16 splits); under DCP8 at concurrency 4 the MLA layers run vLLM's attention ops and the rest of the layer is fused.
+      - **Low-latency decode** (the Low-latency decode feature, on at concurrency 1 and 4) sets `decode_backend: latency_specialized`. On MI355X it runs pure decode steps of up to 16 rows on fused FlyDSL kernels; prefill and mixed steps run the default path. Without DCP it serves only 3 or 7 draft tokens with `--max-num-seqs` 1 or 2. At concurrency 1 the server log shows the fused path running the sparse MLA attention itself (the one-launch prologue, the indexer's scoring and DSA split-K, 16 splits); under DCP8 at concurrency 4 the MLA layers run vLLM's attention ops and the rest of the layer is fused. The pinned image also turns on this path's low-concurrency speedups by default: the `VLLM_K31_BEAT_*` variables and `VLLM_K3_INDEXER_SAMPLED_TOPK`, plus `VLLM_KIMI_SD_DSA_PROLOGUE_INDEXER` where `VLLM_KIMI_SD_DSA_PROLOGUE` is on (concurrency 1). All of them default to 1, so the preset sets none. Some act only at one request: at concurrency 4 the server log reports the fused Markov draft step off with more than one request. The decode backend used from concurrency 16 ignores them.
       - **CUDA graphs.** K3.1 has no `torch.compile` submodule, so vLLM resolves `FULL_AND_PIECEWISE` to `FULL_DECODE_ONLY` and captures decode only. Breakable graphs (`VLLM_USE_BREAKABLE_CUDAGRAPH=1`, from the AMD profile) are what let the points from concurrency 16 capture the prefill sizes too. They cost graph memory, which comes out of the KV cache, so keep the capture list to the sizes the workload uses. Concurrency 1 and 4 capture decode sizes only and set it to 0.

[Bugfix][Mamba] Don't cache a block that a mid-block prefill resume ran past (#67717)

Signed-off-by: wzhao18 <wzhao18.sz@gmail.com>
Co-authored-by: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

     assert cached[0].block_hash_num_tokens == 14
 
 
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("case", ["local", "local_junction", "external"])
+def test_mid_block_resume_running_past_block_end_does_not_cache_it(case):
+    """A prefill chunk that resumes inside a Mamba block and runs past its end
+    leaves that block at the resume state, so it must not get the full-block
+    hash (nor be offered to a connector as the block-end state)."""
+    hash_block_size, mamba_block_size, mamba_group = 16, 64, 1
+    manager = make_full_mamba_manager(
+        dcp_world_size=1,
+        hash_block_size=hash_block_size,
+        full_block_size=hash_block_size,
+        mamba_block_size=mamba_block_size,
+        num_blocks=128,
+        num_prefill_checkpoint_blocks=1,
+    )
+    # "local_junction": default sparse retention, where block 1 is retained
+    # because 128 is the shared-prefix junction left by a sibling.
+    manager.coordinator.retention_interval = 0 if case == "local_junction" else None
+    scheduler = SimpleNamespace(
+        block_size=mamba_block_size,
+        cache_config=SimpleNamespace(block_size=mamba_block_size),
+        hash_block_size=hash_block_size,
+        max_num_scheduled_tokens=8192,
+        scheduler_config=SimpleNamespace(long_prefill_token_threshold=0),
+        use_eagle_block_drop=False,
+        num_hash_lookahead_tokens=0,
+        mamba_partial_cache_hit=True,
+        mamba_shared_prefix_checkpoint=False,
+        mamba_has_prefill_checkpoint_blocks=True,
+        mamba_prefill_checkpoint_alignment=16,
+    )
+    tokens = list(range(1000, 1300))
+
+    def prefill(request_id, prompt, num_external=0):
+        request = make_request(request_id, prompt, hash_block_size, sha256)
+        computed, num_hit, junction = manager.get_computed_blocks(request)
+        request.shared_prefix_boundary = junction
+        start = num_hit + num_external
+        num_new = Scheduler._mamba_block_aligned_split(
+            scheduler, request, len(prompt) - start, num_hit, num_external
+        )
+        chunks = [(start, num_new)]
+        assert (
+            manager.allocate_slots(
+                request,
+                num_new,
+                num_hit,
+                computed,
+                num_external_computed_tokens=num_external,
+            )
+            is not None
+        )
+        request.num_computed_tokens = start + num_new
+        while request.num_computed_tokens < len(prompt):
+            manager.new_step_starts()
+            start = request.num_computed_tokens
+            num_new = Scheduler._mamba_block_aligned_split(
+                scheduler, request, len(prompt) - start
+            )
+            chunks.append((start, num_new))
+            assert manager.allocate_slots(request, num_new) is not None
+            request.num_computed_tokens = start + num_new
+        manager.new_step_starts()
+        return request, num_hit, chunks
+
+    if case == "local_junction":
+        manager.free(prefill("sibling", tokens[:130] + [7] * 40)[0])
+    if case != "external":
+        manager.free(prefill("owner", tokens[:100])[0])  # caches state@96
+    drain_boundary_state_offloads(manager)
+
+    # Resume at 96, inside block 1 = [64, 128). With an internal checkpoint
+    # column past the resume block, the split runs [96, 230) in one step.
+    resume, num_hit, chunks = prefill(
+        "resume", tokens[:230], num_external=96 if case == "external" else 0
+    )
+    assert num_hit == (0 if case == "external" else 96)
+    assert chunks == [(96, 134)]
+    resumed_block = manager.get_blocks("resume").blocks[mamba_group][1]
+    offloads = drain_boundary_state_offloads(manager).get("resume", [])
+    manager.free(resume)
+    manager.new_step_starts()
+
+    assert resumed_block.block_hash_num_tokens != 128
+    assert (mamba_group, resumed_block.block_id, 128) not in offloads
+    probe = make_request("probe", tokens[:128] + [9] * 16, hash_block_size, sha256)
+    _, num_hit, _ = manager.get_computed_blocks(probe)
+    assert num_hit == (0 if case == "external" else 96)
+

 - Older MoRI builds leave a stale HIP error behind when the fabric-handle probe fails (e.g. on a single MI355X node), and the next PyTorch allocation raises `operation not supported`.
 
+### FlashInfer MegaMoE on SM107
+
+`--moe-backend flashinfer_moe_ep_cutedsl --enable-expert-parallel` runs FlashInfer's CuTeDSL MegaMoE on SM107 (compute capability 10.7, NVIDIA Rubin) GPUs for NVFP4 expert checkpoints. ModelOpt NVFP4 is the validated format; compressed-tensors NVFP4 checkpoints have not yet been tested on SM107. It is never selected automatically.
+
+Requirements:
+
+- The `nvshmem4py-cu13` package (`uv pip install nvshmem4py-cu13`).
+- `CUTE_DSL_ARCH=sm_107a` exported before vLLM starts.
+- `NVSHMEM_SYMMETRIC_SIZE`: `(2 * top_k + 1) * hidden_size * max_num_batched_tokens` bytes is enough; set it only if that exceeds NVSHMEM's default heap size.
+
+Behavior:
+
+- The checkpoint's activation input scales (the layer maximum over the EP group) set the activation and FC1-output quantization. A non-finite scale, or a layer whose scales are all zero, fails at load.

+    Tokens are quantized on their source rank, so the activation grid is the
+    layer maximum over every EP rank. The alphas are scaled in place and keep
+    aliasing the layer's weight global scales. Collective over the EP group:
+    every EP rank must call it for the same MoE layers in the same order.

@@ -16,6 +16,24 @@ Depending on the use case, there are two possible strategies:
 
 Both approaches are under active development.
 
+### DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash on ROCm
+
+ROCm supports eager prefill context parallelism for the text-only
+DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash model:
+
+```bash
+VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER=1 vllm serve deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash \
+  --language-model-only \
+  --tensor-parallel-size 2 \
+  --prefill-context-parallel-size 2 \
+  --no-enable-prefix-caching \
+  --enforce-eager
+```
+
+This configuration requires PP=DP=DCP=1 and does not support microbatching,
+speculative decoding, KV transfer, prefix caching, MegaMoE, or the ROCm
+monokernel. TP and PCP multiply, so TP=2 with PCP=2 requires four GPUs.
+
 ## Decode Context Parallel
 
 Due to the auto-regressive nature of decoding, every decoding step needs to compute a small amount of query tokens w.r.t. a large number of key/value tokens stored in the paged KV cache. The core of decode context parallel is how to shard the KV cache across GPUs.
